verdict.rationale: Termius is an SSH/Mosh/SFTP terminal client for connecting to and managing servers. Creating pull requests on hosted Git platforms is outside that product category, and nothing in the evidence shows Termius ships any Git-hosting or pull-request capability. Running a Git CLI inside a remote shell would be a user-side workaround, not a Termius feature.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create pull requests on hosted Git platforms directly from my device
